feature_match_specificity_audit.note: Each reviewed phrase remains individually safe: matching.py's new distinguishing-content-token gate (feature_present()) still requires the phrase's own real distinguishing concept -- 'meal(s)'/'palpitat(ions)' -- to be present, not merely the relational/generic words it shares with unrelated text.

morphology_normalization.new_suffix_rule_this_round: ish (e.g. feverish -> fever) -- a general, productive English adjectival suffix, added after removing the truncation fallback surfaced a real, narrow case (a plain 'fever' typical_feature failing to match 'felt a little feverish' text) that the old truncation shortcut used to cover by accident.
negative_controls_verified: selfish/finish (does not falsely satisfy an unrelated 'self harm' phrase)

short_alias_word_boundary_safety.defect_found_and_fixed_this_round: feature_present()'s EXACT/substring tier used a naive `feature in finding` substring check, so a short KB disease-name alias (e.g. pulmonary_embolism's 'PE', acute_coronary_syndrome's 'MI') matched as a raw substring inside a completely unrelated word ('PE' inside 'period', 'MI' inside 'family') -- discovered via a development case where a reproductive-age patient's 'period is about seven weeks late' spuriously activated pulmonary embolism and hijacked the candidate pool. Fixed with a word-boundary-safe check (`_exact_phrase_present`); legitimate exact matches (e.g. 'known PE diagnosed last year') still work.

contextual_safety_activation.mechanism: nova_agent/contextual_safety.py (NEW) -- a small table of narrow, predicate-gated CONTEXTUAL activation rules (currently: ectopic_pregnancy, gated on reproductive-age female + abdominal/pelvic symptoms or unexplained syncope/GI bleeding, and explicitly never activated on demographics alone or when pregnant=False is known) additive to (never replacing) the small fixed CROSS_CUTTING_DANGEROUS_DIAGNOSES safety net.
verified_properties: activation requires both demographic AND symptom-context predicates, never demographics alone
explicit pregnant=False rules the activation out entirely
an activated candidate can still leave the differential via existing resolution logic once evidence excludes it (not unconditionally immortal)

generalizes beyond ectopic pregnancy -- verified in Blind v15's own reproductive_age_emergency category via a second mechanism (tier2:ovarian_torsion), which the fixed activation table does not itself enumerate but which reaches the pool through the same symptom/demographic context signals

diagnostic_specificity_vs_generic_severi.mechanism: nova_agent/severity_evidence.py's new GENERIC_PHYSIOLOGIC_SEVERITY_WORDS set + differential.py's _specificity_multiplier(): a typical_feature phrase whose content words are ENTIRELY generic severity markers (hypotension, tachycardia, tachypnea, hypoxia, fever, shock, ...) receives a reduced (never zero) specificity multiplier, so stacked generic-severity matches can no longer outscore a genuinely disease-specific finding.
diagnostic_specificity_vs_generic_severi.ranking_remains_deterministic_note: No calibrated/fabricated probabilities introduced -- LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CONFIRMATORY-style specificity remains a deterministic multiplier on an interpretable integer-ish score, per spec ("do not pretend to use calibrated probabilities").

multilingual_concept_normalization.mechanism: nova_agent/multilingual_concepts.py (NEW) -- a bounded table mapping Korean/Japanese phrases for the currently-supported clinical domains (pain, abdominal/chest pain, headache, weakness, numbness, dyspnea, fever, vomiting, diarrhea, GI bleeding, dizziness, syncope) to the SAME canonical chief_complaint.py concept tags English phrasing already routes to, merged into CONCEPT_ALIASES at import time.
multilingual_concept_normalization.no_translation_api_used_note: No Google Translate/external LLM translation/online translation API of any kind -- fully offline, dependency-light, per spec. No separate per-language reasoning logic: a matched phrase flows through the identical exact/alias/fuzzy matching machinery as English.

forced_low_evidence_diagnosis_metadata.mechanism: PatientState gains three independent flags (final_diagnosis_forced_due_to_turn_limit, final_diagnosis_zero_evidence_at_diagnosis, final_diagnosis_fallback_candidate_selected), staged by orchestrator.decide() and recorded by record_diagnose(). competition/adapter.py always attaches these to the wire response metadata; the action_type itself only relabels to the new, explicitly-speculative 'INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION' value when NovaConfig.competition_supports_insufficient_information is deliberately turned on (default False, since no official schema confirms this label exists).
forced_low_evidence_diagnosis_metadata.real_bug_found_and_fixed_this_round: safety_validator.py's merge_differential() LLM-reconstruction path was not copying `fallback_candidate` from the deterministic match, silently defaulting it to False for every LLM/mock-reconstructed differential entry -- weakening Round D's own zero-evidence/UNKNOWN_PRESENTATION safety gate whenever the differential was reconstructed through that path (in practice, essentially always under the mock provider). Fixed.
forced_low_evidence_diagnosis_metadata.discriminator_priority_note: Verified (not retuned, per spec) that action_selector's existing utility function already prioritizes a plausible critical diagnosis's own high-specificity confirmatory test (e.g. troponin for ACS) over generic/low-value workup, when both are safe and legal.

blind_v15.note: WORSE than Blind v14 (83.7%/13.0% miss) on both scored accuracy and critical miss rate -- reported honestly, as-is, with NO improvement claimed, per this round's explicit discipline. No reasoning/retrieval code was modified in response to this result; blind_cases_v15.py was not edited after this run. Read-only root-cause tracing (artifacts/blind_runs/blind_v15_failure_analysis.md) found the drop is NOT primarily a Round E regression (all five of this round's own defect fixes independently verified via unit tests, dev cases, and the full unchanged regression suite) but traces to a DIFFERENT, previously out-of-scope architectural boundary: the legacy top-5 differential-candidate cap combined with an insertion-order tie-break among zero-scored candidates on early turns, which Blind v15's broader, harder, more lay/vague/sparse-evidence-heavy required category spread exposes far more than Blind v14's narrower set did. Confirmed pre-existing (not new this round) by reproducing the identical mechanism on Blind v14's own historical case content run against the current, fully Round-E-fixed code. Flagged as the top architectural priority for a future round.
